music.title: Type It, Watch It
music.style: instrumental, playful funky breakbeat with live slap bass, clavinet, bright brass stabs and crisp breakbeat drums, 100 bpm, 0-8 seconds only clavinet riff and soft hi-hat, a big brass hit and full groove drop at 14 seconds, distinct sections every 20 seconds (funk band, then piano house groove, then a half-time hip-hop break around 75 seconds, then the full band returns louder), confident joyful mood, triumphant final brass hit and clean ending, no vocals
